title: keetia zanzibarica subsp. gentilii
intro: Keetia zanzibarica subsp. gentilii, commonly known as a plant species within the Rubiaceae family, is a flowering plant native to tropical Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Keetia zanzibarica subsp. gentilii include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of fever. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
